name: WiseAI
description: WiseAI is an iOS app for getting genuinely good at using AI, in about 10 minutes a day. Short interactive lessons, hands-on practice, a curated daily AI news brief, and Wurtle Lock, a Screen Time feature that locks your distracting apps until you finish a lesson. Requires a subscription.
slogan: Get good at AI in 10 minutes a day
featureList: Wurtle Lock: distracting apps stay locked until you finish a lesson
A two-minute daily AI news brief, personalized to your role
71 AI tools compared, with lessons that teach them
A free AI IQ test at /iq, no signup required
Streaks, XP, and a progressive unlock path

audience.audienceType: Busy professionals, students, founders, and creators who want to use AI well at work

offers.description: Full access, billed yearly. No free trial.
